title: Identity or Prompt Noise? A Calibrated Invariance Audit of LLM Code Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.22511v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Identity cues are irrelevant to a fixed programming specification, but raw counterfactual differences can arise from unequal samples and prompt wording. We audit 30.73 million executed Python generations from seven checkpoints on HumanEval+ and MBPP+, supplemented by an exploratory 550B slice, under model-assigned gender, country, and occupation personas. Within-task randomization and false-discovery-rate control identify occupation as the most consistent structural axis: CodeBLEU dispersion exceeds its exchangeability null in 10/14 model--benchmark cells, remains significant in 8/12 full-coverage cells, and exceeds the country ratio in every paired cell, although the median excess is only 0.141 points. In six high-pass-rate cells, occupation dispersion replicates across token similarity, length, comments, reference similarity, and complexity, while pass-rate dispersion is significant in none. Country leads raw dispersion in 12/14 cells

translated_title: 是身份还是提示噪声？大语言模型代码生成的校准不变性审计
translated_abstract: 身份线索与固定的编程规约无关，但原始的反事实差异可能源于样本数量不均和提示措辞的不同。我们在模型被赋予性别、国家和职业三种人设的条件下，审计了七个模型检查点在HumanEval+和MBPP+基准上生成的3073万条已执行Python代码，并辅以一个探索性的550B切片。通过任务内随机化和错误发现率控制，我们发现职业是最一致的结构性影响轴线：CodeBLEU离散度在14个模型-基准组合中的10个超过了其可交换性零假设，在12个全覆盖组合中的8个仍然显著，并且在每一对配对组合中都超过国家维度，尽管中位超额仅为0.141个点。在六个高通过率组合中，职业离散度在标记相似度、长度、注释、参考相似度和复杂度等多个指标上均可复现，而通过率离散度则均不显著。国家维度在14个组合中的12个中领先于原始离散度。
tldr: 该研究通过任务内随机化和错误发现率控制，对3073万条已执行的代码生成结果进行校准的不变性审计，发现职业人设是影响大语言模型代码生成输出一致性的最稳定结构因素（但效应极小），且功能性正确性（通过率）未受显著影响。
en_tdlr: Through a calibrated invariance audit of 30.73 million executed Python generations with within-task randomization and false-discovery-rate control, this study finds that occupation personas constitute the most consistent structural axis of variation in LLM code generation—though with negligible effect sizes—while functional correctness (pass rates) remains unaffected.
